post.description: A batch written against an older revision is rebased server-side and applied; the ops that had to be rewritten come back under `rebased`. Two writers who typed different text into the same caption cannot be reconciled by the server, so that is a 409 `edg/conflict` carrying `{latestRevision, opsSince, conflicts}` — never the document. More than 200 revisions behind is `edg/too_stale`: reload.

The server mints the `Resegment` op, so the audited record of what happened carries an id this API can vouch for. Every previous segment id is tombstoned; style, position and `hidden` are inherited by whichever new segment overlaps.

post.description: History is never rewritten: the restore is appended, so restoring a later snapshot undoes it. The transcript is not rolled back — words live in their own table and a spelling fixed after the snapshot stays fixed. A snapshot that names a word the transcript no longer has live is refused with `edg/restore_invalid` and the dangling ids, rather than written as a caption nothing can render.

info.title: Aksharo API
info.description: Errors use the envelope `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }` with `namespace/slug` codes (CONTRACTS section 8).

balanceTenths.description: Cached balance in tenths of a credit (CONTRACTS §0).

lots.description: Live lots, soonest-expiring first then FIFO.

deltaTenths.description: Positive credits a workspace, negative credits spent.

jobType.description: The job's queue, when refType is "job".

priority.description: Lower runs first; derived from the workspace's plan.

jobKey.description: Deduplication key: one live job per (workspace, key).

attemptId.description: Identifies this run of the job.

creditsChargedTenths.description: Credits in tenths: the hold while running, the charge once finished.

maxQueueWaitMs.description: Milliseconds this job may wait in `queued`.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page.

kind.description: What happened. The client renders its own wording per locale, so the row carries no text of its own.

workspaceId.description: Workspace this belongs to, if any.

data.description: Template variables: project name, minutes remaining, a deep link.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page.

unread.description: Unread rows for this user across every page — the bell's badge.

deduplicated.description: True when an identical run was already queued.

tenths.description: Tenths of a credit held for this kind.

totalTenths.description: Sum of `tenths` across every kind in this request.

region.description: The workspace jurisdiction this call was pinned to.

disclosure.description: Consent notice, ASCI-friendly labelling (brief §5): show verbatim next to generated content.

tenths.description: Credits held before the job was enqueued, in tenths.

credits.description: "1.2" — for display only, never for arithmetic.

durationMs.description: Media duration the quote was computed from.

transcriptId.description: The transcript the completion will write.

status.description: `queued`, or the live job's status when deduplicated.

deduplicated.description: True when a transcription was already running and none was enqueued.

source.description: Which of the two LID signals (D14).

before.description: The text as the provider sent it.

after.description: The text as it was stored.

reason.description: Why, in a form a human can review.

correctionCount.description: Total corrections, including any not listed.

truncated.description: True when `corrections` is a prefix of the full log.

languageDisagreement.description: True when the acoustic and orthographic LID signals disagreed.

revision.description: Transcript revision these chunks belong to.

durationMs.description: End of the last chunk, in media ms.

nextCursor.description: Last `chunkIdx` returned; pass as `cursor`. `null` at the end.

revision.description: Compare-and-swap counter; one accepted batch raises it by 1.

schemaVersion.description: EDG schema generation (D28). Always 2 in this wave.

hot.description: `EdgHot` from `@montaj/edg` (CONTRACTS §2): meta, media, transcript, canvas, styles.

segments.description: First page of segments, in `seq` order.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to `/edg/segments` for the next page.

revision.description: Revision the page was read at.

ops.description: The ops as applied. Empty means the state was replaced (a snapshot restore).

author.description: User id, or null for a worker.

opId.description: The client op id that did not land.

reason.description: Closed enum (`packages/edg` README). Never free text.

message.description: Operator-facing detail; not for end users.

revision.description: The revision after the batch; unchanged when nothing applied.

rebased.description: Op ids applied after a server-side rebase.

revision.description: The new revision the restore appended.

secret.description: Base32 TOTP secret; also encoded in `otpauthUrl`.

otpauthUrl.description: otpauth:// URI for a QR code in an authenticator app.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the admin token expires (1800).

jobKey.description: Deduplication key of the failed job.

lastError.description: `{code, message, retryable}` of the final attempt.

worstCaseTenths.description: Credits held in tenths; a replay reserves this again.

distinctErrors.description: Distinct error codes among the pending rows.

dryRun.description: Nothing changed; the counts are a projection.

attemptId.description: The ULID minted for the replay.

attemptNo.description: 1-based: three failures then a replay is 4.

holdReleased.description: Whether a credit hold was actually released.

tenths.description: Credits held before the job was enqueued, in tenths.

credits.description: "1.2" — for display only, never for arithmetic.

durationMs.description: Media duration the quote was computed from.

cleanId.description: The `audio_cleans` row this run will write to.

deduplicated.description: True when an identical live run already existed.

outputLufs.description: Approximate LUFS after cleaning and normalising.

clippingCount.description: Samples at or beyond full scale in the output.

truePeakDbtp.description: Peak true level of the output, dBTP.

cleanedAudioUrl.description: Signed GET URL for the cleaned 48 kHz WAV, when succeeded.

previewOriginalUrl.description: Signed GET URL for the original-track A/B preview clip.

previewCleanedUrl.description: Signed GET URL for the cleaned-track A/B preview clip.

jobId.description: The `ai.pass` job id; poll `GET /jobs/{id}` or watch `job.completed`.

passId.description: The pass id `MergePass` will land under once the job completes.

deduplicated.description: True when an autocut for this project was already queued or running.
True when a transliteration to this script was already running.

tenths.description: Credits held for this job, in tenths.

credits.description: "1.5" — for display only, never for arithmetic.

targetLanguage.description: BCP-47 tag this job translates to.

deduplicated.description: True when a translation to this language was already running.

language.description: For `translated`: the BCP-47 target it currently holds.

tenths.description: Credits held, in tenths. 0 for browser and subtitle exports.

credits.description: "0.5" — for display only, never for arithmetic.

rawUrl.description: 15-minute signed GET for the ORIGINAL media (S3).

proxyUrl.description: 15-minute signed GET for the 540p proxy (R2), when one exists.

watermarkUrl.description: 15-minute signed GET for the watermark PNG (R2), when the manifest carries one.

status.description: `queued`, or the live job's status when deduplicated.

deduplicated.description: True when an identical job was already running.

manifest.description: The signed `RenderManifest` (`@montaj/render-manifest`), present on the browser path only — the browser renders locally and never uploads. Verify it before drawing a frame.

sources.description: Present on the browser path only. NOT part of the signed manifest body — issued alongside it, and refreshable at `GET /exports/manifests/{id}/sources` once these expire.

job.description: Present on the cloud path only.

uploadUrl.description: Single-shot presigned PUT URL for the PNG bytes.

error.description: Present only when the check failed.

secret.description: The signing secret. Shown once — store it now.
